@graph.description: Lin Source Lab researches how expert creators can make original ideas durable, citeable, and recoverable in AI retrieval systems.

@graph.headline: A serious idea needs a source page before it needs more posts
@graph.abstract: Professional creators should publish one canonical source page for each serious idea, then distribute platform variants that point back to that source.
@graph.citation: Lin Source Lab, "A serious idea needs a source page before it needs more posts," Source Passport v1, https://demo.creator-source.local/s/durable-source-page
